etymologies.etymologyHTML: Blend of transfer +‎ resistor. Said to have been coined by American engineer John Robinson Pierce in 1947.

definitions.definition: (semiconductors) A solid-state semiconductor device, with three terminals, which can be used for amplification, switching, voltage stabilization, signal modulation, and many other functions.

quote.citation: 1978, Billy Joel, Half a Mile Away:
quote.text: Turn your transistor on and let the music play
